full_text:
Article 9 (Procedure for Corrective Requests)
① The corrective action plan specified in paragraph 2 of Article 3(4) must be submitted to the head of the managing agency within 30 days from the date the corrective request was received.
② If the head of the managing agency determines that the corrective action plan submitted in accordance with paragraph 1 does not specifically reflect the content of the corrective request or is impossible to implement, they may request its modification or supplementation.
③ The head of the managing agency must notify the relevant association of the termination of the corrective request within 7 days from the date the termination is decided in accordance with paragraph 4 of Article 3(4).
